why: Keep each sync conflict, so a phone can settle it later instead of dropping the older edit

files.sql:
-- One row per edit two devices made to the same note before either synced.
CREATE TABLE sync_conflicts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  note_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  device_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id),
  base_version integer NOT NULL,
  theirs jsonb NOT NULL,
  settled_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE sync_conflicts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Phones ask only for what is still open.
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY sync_conflicts_open_idx
  ON sync_conflicts (note_id, created_at DESC)
  WHERE settled_at IS NULL;
